propositions: Fault-seeded matrix reveals generic reads-under-sync-contention property misses F3/F6 partial-success faults (shape-valid but content-incomplete records) that the original CLI regression test uniquely detects.

Reverting slim-fetch-ledge fix leaves both burst tests green; only deterministic held-lock tests (T1, T4) detect the actual _RECONVERGE_LOCK_TIMEOUT regression, contradicting the burst test's stated purpose.
Generic property catches F5 (35s stall) and F7 (empty list surface) that the original test misses, establishing bidirectional non-subsumption; the two oracles are complements, not duplicates.

Removal of the original test forfeits real detection power per Just et al. FSE 2014 mutation-score criterion and contradicts Go stdlib precedent, which deleted unreliable storm tests while keeping deterministic ones.
Test consolidation is unsafe without first strengthening the generic property's payload-completeness assertions to close the F3/F6 gap.
